steps.content:
17:10, July 23, N.F. 113
Shalom's Home, Erica Villa, Eastside

steps.speaker: MBCC Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: Sinner Garofano has been subdued. Rating: A-Class. Her condition is not good. She's unconscious and her M-value fluctuates significantly.

steps.speaker: MBCC Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: Given the special situation, with permission from the 9th Agency or the FAC, you will be granted provisional supervision and interrogation rights. But currently, there are no effective measures to control her Mania, so please beware.

steps.speaker: Authoritative Man
steps.content: I'll follow up the procedures with the 9th Agency. For now, this Sinner will be transferred to Paradeisos for management. Once she wakes up, I'll finish the interrogation.

steps.speaker: Authoritative Man
steps.content: You may leave.
The MBCC team nods and exits silently. As soon as no other outsiders remain in the room, the authoritative man turns to the two who've just returned.

steps.speaker: Authoritative Man
steps.content: You should have stayed here, Shalom.

steps.speaker: Authoritative Man
steps.content: What happened?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The plan was to lure the attacker out. I have indeed accomplished it, though in a different way. When the situation changes, the plan follows, no?
She says as she placidly takes off her hat and sunglasses and places them on top of a chest on the side, diverting the man's gaze from Rahu.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your sudden appearance surprises me more, <color=#7683a2>Liaison Officer</color>. Is there a new order?

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: Paradeisos wants to confirm if you've completed your task. Things have changed over there. They have a new mission for you.

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: Get ready and tend to your injuries. We leave tonight.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I still have a few words for Miss Garofano. Is it urgent?

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: I'll finish the interrogation for you. It's a highly urgent assignment. Be prepared to go all out this time.
Shalom is silent for a second.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...I see. Meaning the possibility of death is high. When I die, who's gonna take over? Have you found my <color=#fb9259>replacement</color>?

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: We'll see to that soon. As I said, this is an urgent matter.
As he speaks, the Liaison Officer takes a step toward Shalom but is stopped by someone. It's Rahu.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...This damned familiar taste of rigidity, arrogance, indifference, and disregard. Good old Paradeisos.

Without the face mask's protection, the taste instantly recalls the distant nightmare. A tornado of emotions seizes her, hatred, anger, and pain gnawing at Rahu's sanity. If she had her shields, she would already be wielding them furiously.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I've received an order to protect this woman.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I can't just stand back and watch when her life's being threatened.

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: ...FAC, Special Task Force, Sinner Rahu.

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: She should be on the BR-002 mission in West District now. Why is she here?

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: Shalom, your mission is to be the bait. Bait shouldn't need protection. It contradicts the purpose of the plan. Why did you recruit her?
She shifts the side of her body and slots herself between the Liaison Officer and Rahu.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You need not worry. It's all for the plan. I am fully aware of the importance of the new mission. Even if the chance of success is slim and I'll likely die, I'm all ready.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's a shame though. We've made huge progress on the other mission. Besides that Sinner assassin, we've also traced her source of intelligence. If we keep digging, I suppose... we may be able to locate the entrance of the Underground.

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: What...!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes, we're at a critical point and the same chance may not come again. If I die, the clue may be lost before my replacement takes over.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What would be your decision, Liaison Officer?

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: Both matters require urgent attention. This is not a decision I can make, I should report it...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No need. Time is scarce, and none of us here can afford to miss the chance. I have a proposal that can solve both problems.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'll accept the new mission and leave for West District immediately. After, you'll find a replacement if there's a need for one.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: As for the work here, you may delegate it fully to this FAC soldier.
Rahu's eyes widen, but Shalom pays no attention to her shock and simply smiles casually at the Paradeisos Liaison Officer.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This FAC soldier has performed splendidly as my bodyguard. She is reliable and capable of serving Paradeisos in my stead. I won't say she outshines me in all aspects, but in some, she can certainly do a better job than I can.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The 9th Agency's investigation will yield results soon, and you should let her follow it up. If we're lucky, we'll find the Underground's entrance in no time.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The Shepherd's location is now unknown, but the Underground's threat is intensifying. Paradeisos could use more reliable Sinners.
It sounds like a tempting offer. The Liaison Officer has clearly taken the bait and is mulling it over.

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: ...It's worth trying.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: In that case, I'll leave Garofano's interrogation to you.
The Liaison Officer nods and leaves, seeming to agree that time is not on their side. When Rahu and Shalom are left alone in the room, Shalom finally turns to smile at Rahu.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: See, thanks to me, you're only a step away from Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: And must I watch you die too?
Shalom smiled, a hint of resignation in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Only you'd care about a tool's death, which means you're not qualified to be a tool yet. Don't waste the chance I've given you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Didn't you swear to infiltrate Paradeisos and fulfill your mission? Know your priorities and focus on your duties. Paradeisos doesn't need weak minds.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Or am I more important than your one and only master? You'd give up your revenge plan for me?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Stop joking.

The mention of Varna only reminds Rahu of her dying face. She should have protected Varna, but Varna sacrificed her life to save Rahu instead. What a joke. And somehow she recalls that at this juncture.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Don't get the wrong idea. This is a test you must complete. You shouldn't waste more time here.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Accomplish your mission. Find the patron and source of intelligence behind this series of attacks, follow the clues, and uncover everything about the Underground. Whatever happens, keep moving and don't look back.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Only when you serve as a good tool, find them what they need, and enter Paradeisos, the plan I mapped out for you can be considered a success.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: But what about you...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I did recruit you as my bodyguard to avoid getting hurt or killed. But in the long run, my fate is always held in the hands of my users. Whether you're there makes no difference.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So don't worry about it. Walk your own path.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You've got one now.
Rahu's fists clench and relax a few times. Finally, she collects herself.

Shalom is right. Everyone has their own path. After all these years, Rahu knew very well what she should do. Her realization weighed much heavier than the slight frustration she felt at the moment. But...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...You get me. My life was torn into pieces long ago. Vengeance is the only thing that got me here. I'd give up everything for it without a second thought.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Along the way, you've helped me find myself and shown me where to go.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Thank you for keeping your promise. I won't let you down. The test, the mission, whatever you ask of me, I'll get them done.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: But I don't want a chance exchanged with somebody's life. Don't make me a laughing stock again.
She took a half step back, her expression serious, and bowed to the woman before her, in her capacity as an FAC member.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You asked for my protection. Then give me a chance to realize my promise.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Don't die.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...You'll have it.

steps.speaker: Weather Forecast
steps.content: With the recent changes in West District, a new wave of Mania Flux is expanding and the FAC has launched another emergency Blue Rain decontamination program that is expected to last 3 days.

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: I got the transfer order. What is this about? You're getting transferred? Where? Paradeisos? Did you really approach them by yourself?!

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: You can't get back at them alone and so recklessly. You're gonna get yourself killed!

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: We'll work out something together. I'll help you this time. Come back! Instructor and everyone wants you to be alive and well, not dead!

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: Please, you're my last comrade, Rahu!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Accomplish your mission. Find the patron and source of intelligence behind this series of attacks, follow the clues, and uncover everything about the Underground. Whatever happens, keep moving and don't look back.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Walk your own path. You've got one now.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Conrad.

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: ...Yes?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Thanks. Without you, I'd have already died a thousand times. You gave a home to a mad stray like me.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: In the coming days, visit the graves of everyone on my behalf.

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: ...What do you mean? Are you going on some suicide mission?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No, no suicide missions for me anymore. The path before me is no longer dark. I know clearly what I must do from now on.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Take care of yourself, brother. When it's all over, I still wanna come home.

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: Rahu?! Hey! Rahu!!
Rahu hung up the phone. Reflecting on her past self, she found it somewhat amusing. If Varna were here, she would undoubtedly tease her even more relentlessly.
Perhaps she should visit her later. Being preoccupied with thoughts of revenge, it has been a long time since she last went to the cemetery.
Rahu mounts her motorbike, and disappears into the Blue Rain.
